case_name: Prasad Enviro Labs Private Limited vs Union Of India
author: C.T. Ravikumar

paragraphs.text:
CIVIL ORIGINAL JURISDICTION

 I.A. No. 132844 OF 2021

 Civil Appeal No.1146 OF 2021

 PRASAD ENVIRO LABS PRIVATE LIMITED & ORS. Appellant(s)

 VERSUS

 UNION OF INDIA & ORS. Respondent(s)

 O R D E R
Interlocutory Application No. 132844 of 2021 is filed seeking

 permission to withdraw this Civil Appeal.
In the said circumstances, in terms of the application, the

 above I. A. No. 132844 of 2021 is allowed and the Civil Appeal

 stands dismissed as withdrawn.
.................................J.
 [C.T.RAVIKUMAR]

 NEW DELHI;
NOVEMBER 15, 2021
